title: University of Michigan consumer sentiment — final (Nov 2026), the first reading whose interviews open on midterm election day
source: UMICH: TWO of the publisher's own 2026 scheduling documents, both fetched direct and PDF-inflated 2026-09-10 by this event's own initial research. (1) `2026 Release Dates`, data.sca.isr.umich.edu/fetchdoc.php?docid=79628 (HTTP 200, 132,710 bytes), whose text layer reads verbatim "November 20" / "November Final" alongside all twelve months. (2) `2026 Interview Dates`, data.sca.isr.umich.edu/fetchdoc.php?docid=79629 (HTTP 200, 89,846 bytes) — a document neither prior UMich ledger found — whose November row reads verbatim "October 20 IW Begins / November 2 Prelim Ends / November 16 IW Ends", publishing the collection window both siblings could only infer. Promoted estimate -> confirmed and EST: -> UMICH: on the umich-sentiment-final-2026-09-25 precedent (its own initial research promoted off document 79628 alone); this one clears the bar with a second primary. NO CLOCK TIME appears in either document, and the apex host sca.isr.umich.edu did NOT RESOLVE from this session (`Could not resolve host`, both curl and getent, reproducing the same DNS failure the 09-25 ledger hit on 2026-09-04 — data.sca.isr.umich.edu and its alias data.umsurvey.org do resolve), so 10:00 ET is CUSTOMARY, NOT SOURCED and the title no longer asserts it. Confirmed is a claim about the SCHEDULED DATE only. Discovered 2026-09-09 as proposals/umich-sentiment-final-2026-11-20.from-case-shiller-hpi-2026-11-24.json, whose finding this canonical file carries forward
notes: PULL-FORWARD MECHANICALLY CLOSED, not asserted: November's final is the 3rd Friday (20th) rather than the last (27th) because 2026-11-27 IS A FRIDAY and IS the tracked thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27; December's is the 18th rather than the 25th because 2026-12-25 IS A FRIDAY and IS the tracked christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25. These are the two largest final-to-month-end gaps of 2026 (10d and 13d). Contrast S&P DJI's `last Tuesday' rule, which has no holiday carve-out and puts case-shiller-hpi-2026-11-24 inside Thanksgiving week — the comparison the proposing lane filed this for. WHAT DOCUMENT 79629 SETTLES: the release-dates document warns "November and December are a bit off this schedule due to holidays," and both prior UMich ledgers had to carry that as a limit on their inferred windows. Checked against the published windows for all twelve months, the normal collection rule holds EXACTLY for November and December; the only two months that deviate are JANUARY and APRIL (prelim interviewing ends a Tuesday, not the Monday) — the caveat names the wrong months, and it is about release dates, not interviewing. WHY IT EARNS AN ENTRY: interviews for the 11-06 prelim end Monday 2026-11-02, one day before the polls open, so the exclusive 2026-11-03 -> 11-16 stretch OPENS ON midterm-elections-2026-11-03 and also carries jobs-2026-11-06, cpi-2026-11-10, us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 and ppi-2026-11-13. The prelim, not the final, owns fomc-2026-10-28. READ IT, DO NOT TRADE IT: `symbols: []`, `low` impact, no house playbook is macro-keyed, and this ledger MEASURED the tempting story to a null — across the 12 midterm years 1978-2022 the November-minus-October change in FRED's UMCSENT has median -1.10 and mean +0.01, up in 5 of 12, indistinguishable from non-election years. 2026-11-20 is also opex-2026-11-20, one of only three 2026 finals landing on a monthly expiry, and 2026 opex Fridays have run at roughly double an ordinary session (median |move| 1.010% vs 0.510%, n=7) while finals have run at par (0.534%, n=8) — so the tape that day belongs to the expiry, not the survey.
